text:
A student makes aqueous copper(II) chloride by adding excess copper(II) carbonate to dilute
hydrochloric acid.
What is the next step in the method in the formation of solid copper(II) chloride?
A
crystallisation
B
evaporation
C
filtration
D
titration
subject: Chemistry
